confirmed: XRP is about $1.33 Tuesday evening, up about 1.7% over 24 hours, roughly flat (down 0.3%) versus 7 days ago and about 12.3% below 30 days ago (CoinGecko snapshot, 5:57 PM MDT; Kraken last trade $1.3294, 24h range $1.2891 to $1.3329). Bitcoin is back near $80,800, up about 1% on the day, ahead of Wednesday's Fed decision.

BNY now supports XRP and RLUSD custody: Ripple and BNY announced Oct 27 that BNY's Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD for institutional clients. Plans to let BNY clients mint and redeem RLUSD directly, and a tokenized trade finance pilot with C2FO on the XRP Ledger, are still subject to BNY and regulatory approvals. Reported independently by The Block and Cointelegraph.

Ripple and Robinhood partnership: RLUSD is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp by Robinhood and is expected in the Robinhood app later this year; Robinhood will use RLUSD on the XRP Ledger for institutional settlement and adopt Ripple Treasury. No contract value was disclosed. Announced by Ripple Oct 27; reported by Cointelegraph and The Block.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent spoke with Brad Garlinghouse at Swell on Oct 27, saying dollar-backed stablecoins could strengthen the dollar and add demand for Treasuries (American Banker, CoinDesk). He talked about stablecoins and digital assets broadly, not XRP specifically.

Ripple's national trust bank got final OCC approval (announced Oct 26; CoinDesk, Benzinga and others reported it Oct 27). It will manage RLUSD reserves and offer business custody; it cannot take deposits or make loans. Today's deals, like the bank, are mostly about Ripple's stablecoin and services; BNY custody is the one item that directly touches XRP.
not_confirmed: No outlet confirms the '$60 billion in XRP transfers overnight' posts; the closest real figures are an Oct 19 on-ledger volume spike and September futures volume. BNY supporting XRP custody is real, but it is a custody service for institutions, not a purchase of XRP by BNY. Ripple's trust bank is not replacing the Federal Reserve and cannot take deposits or make loans; it is a charter for RLUSD reserves and custody. The CLARITY Act has not been signed into law: the Senate failed to advance it 49 to 50 on Sept 15 and no new vote is scheduled, so 'Trump signs crypto bill' posts are false, and the ones asking you to message them for a wallet guide fit a common scam pattern. The BlackRock MOU announced overnight is with SBI Holdings and Startale about a yen stablecoin; Ripple and XRP are not part of it. GraniteShares' Nov 30 date is for leveraged funds and is the issuer's own filing, not an SEC ruling on XRP. Ripple is not releasing 1.3 billion XRP on Nov 1: the scheduled escrow release is up to 1 billion XRP. No BlackRock XRP ETF filing or BlackRock–Ripple deal exists. Ripple's CEO did not say XRP's market cap will hit '$196 trillion' or price it at $118,920; that post is still being recirculated. Price 'what if' posts ($100, $327,000 and similar) are speculation with no source. Also still unconfirmed: no Bank of America–Ripple partnership, no Trump family quote about XRP. 'Reset is live' countdowns, 'QFS card' help desks, airdrops and move-your-coins messages fit common scam patterns. Details are in the rumors section.

news.headline: Ripple Expands Strategic Digital Assets Collaboration with BNY Across Custody and Tokenized Trade Finance
news.summary: BNY's Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD. Planned RLUSD mint and redeem through BNY and XRPL trade finance work with C2FO are subject to final BNY and regulatory approvals.

news.headline: Ripple, BNY explore using the XRP Ledger to finance approved invoices
news.summary: Independent report on the BNY custody expansion and the C2FO pilot; notes the companies have not said when the proposed services and trade finance applications will launch.

news.headline: Ripple, Robinhood expand partnership to bring RLUSD to retail and institutional markets
news.summary: RLUSD is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, coming to the Robinhood app later this year; Robinhood adopts Ripple Treasury. C2FO told Cointelegraph its Instant Pay service is in testing, with first RLUSD transactions on XRPL expected by year-end.

news.headline: Ripple and Robinhood Partner to Power the Next Generation of Finance
news.summary: Ripple's own announcement of the Robinhood deal across RLUSD, Ripple Treasury and Ripple Prime.

news.headline: Bessent: stablecoins will help ensure dollar dominance
news.summary: At Swell, the Treasury Secretary told Garlinghouse that dollar-backed stablecoins could become an important source of demand for Treasuries, and predicted guardrails against debanking crypto firms.

news.headline: Scott Bessent puts crypto alongside AI and chips in U.S.-China tech race at Ripple conference
news.summary: Bessent framed digital assets as part of a technology contest with China that could fortify the dollar; he did not discuss XRP specifically.

news.headline: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank
news.summary: Independent report on the OCC approval: the bank will manage RLUSD reserves and provide regulated custody, while RLUSD stays issued by Ripple's New York-regulated trust company. RLUSD is about $2.5B in market value, with most reserves held at BNY.

news.headline: Bitcoin dips below $80k as Strategy pauses buying, Fed caution weighs
news.summary: Bitcoin fell 0.5% to about $79,830 early Tuesday and slipped below its month-long $80,000 to $87,000 range; XRP was an outlier, up 0.7% after the trust bank approval. The Fed is expected to hold, with a hawkish tone the main risk.

news.headline: XRP Whales Now Control Most Supply Since 2022
news.summary: On-chain data firm Santiment says wallets with 10M+ XRP hold about 46.87B XRP (about 68.5% of supply), the highest share since November 2022. It is a wallet-size metric and the firm's own interpretation; it does not identify owners.

news.headline: SEC delays GraniteShares 3x Bitcoin, XRP and Ethereum ETFs ahead of US midterms
news.summary: GraniteShares' Oct 26 filing moves the planned effective date of eight proposed 3x long and short daily ETFs, including two XRP funds, to Nov 30. The filing states no reason and is not a rejection. The headline's 'SEC delays' framing overstates it: the issuer filed the delay.

news.headline: BlackRock, SBI Holdings and Startale sign MOU to bridge tokenized money market funds and yen stablecoin (JPYSC)
news.summary: An exploratory agreement to study linking BlackRock's tokenized money market funds with SBI's yen stablecoin JPYSC. No product, network or launch date is set. SBI is a long-time Ripple partner, but Ripple and XRP are not part of this agreement.

news.headline: Ripple Receives Final OCC Approval to Establish National Trust Bank
news.summary: The OCC granted final approval for Ripple National Trust Bank, after conditional approval in December 2025. It will manage segregated RLUSD reserves, act as collateral trustee for RLUSD holders and offer fiduciary digital asset custody. RLUSD issuance stays with Standard Custody & Trust (NYDFS-regulated).

news.headline: Ripple National Trust Bank receives final OCC approval for crypto custody
news.summary: Explains the approval: a fiduciary-only national trust bank (proposed charter 25364) that will not take deposits or make loans. Circle, Paxos and BitGo got conditional approvals in the same December batch.

news.headline: Ripple Treasury Introduces Always-On Corporate Treasury Platform to Modernize Corporate Cash Management
news.summary: Unveiled at Swell: AI-assisted workflow orchestration for treasury teams and '24/7 Returns' on qualifying digital assets such as RLUSD held in a Ripple wallet, for eligible corporate customers.

news.headline: US spot XRP ETFs see $4.25 million in weekly inflows after brief outflow
news.summary: Weekly net inflows of about $4.25M reversed the prior week's $1.84M outflow, while bitcoin, ether and Solana ETFs saw outflows. Relays SoSoValue data.

news.headline: XRP sits 64% below its peak as BlackRock rumors run wild before Swell
news.summary: XRP near $1.28 earlier Monday, about 64% below its $3.65 high; notes no BlackRock XRP deal or filing is confirmed, and reports about $81.8M of net XRP outflows from Upbit, Binance and Coinbase.

news.headline: Aviva Investors steps up digital assets push by tokenising largest fund
news.summary: Aviva Investors rolled out a tokenized share class of its £22 billion Sterling Liquidity Fund on the XRP Ledger, after its dollar-fund class in July, and plans to extend tokenization to other funds. The two tokenized classes hold a little over £86 million; Komainu and Licuido are the custody and tokenization partners.

news.headline: Bitcoin slips under $80,000 as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting
news.summary: Bitcoin fell nearly 2% to about $79,800 in Asian hours Monday; ether and XRP led losses among majors, with XRP down about 3% to $1.28. Traders are watching Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Wednesday press conference for hints of a December hike.

news.headline: XRP Ledger bug fix moved to November after validator support dipped for two hours
news.summary: Support for fixCleanup3_4_0 briefly fell to 26 of 35 validators, resetting its 14-day clock; activation moves from Oct 23 to about Nov 4, and support is now 31 of 35.

news.headline: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million of money-market fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
news.summary: Two $75M subscriptions brought Franklin's tokenized money-market fund (sgBENJI) on XRPL to about 193M shares, roughly $200M, all held in one wallet that shares signers with Franklin's issuing account. Who the investors are is undisclosed. These are fund shares, not XRP purchases.

news.headline: Ripple schedules up to 1 billion XRP escrow release for Nov. 1, 2026
news.summary: Routine monthly escrow unlock at 00:00 UTC Nov 1. In October, 700M of the 1B released was re-locked. How much stays out or is sold is not known in advance.

claims.claim: JUST IN: BNY Mellon, the world's largest custodian, now supports XRP
claims.who: Community accounts on X (e.g. @PacificMist), Oct 27
claims.check: True: BNY's custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD for institutional clients, per Ripple's release and The Block. It is a custody service; it does not mean BNY is buying XRP. Mainstream-corroborated by crypto press, not yet by general financial press in our search.
claims.check_title: The Block: Ripple, BNY explore using the XRP Ledger to finance approved invoices

claims.claim: JUST IN: Ripple $XRP and Robinhood $HOOD officially announce strategic partnership
claims.who: Watcher.Guru and many copy accounts on X, Oct 27
claims.check: True, though the deal centers on Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin, Ripple Treasury and Ripple Prime rather than XRP. Robinhood will use RLUSD on the XRP Ledger for institutional settlement.

claims.claim: JUST IN: Nearly $60 billion in $XRP transfers recorded overnight. What is going on???
claims.who: 'JAKE XRP COMMUNITY' account on X, Oct 27
claims.check: No data source given and no outlet reports it. The nearest real figures are a $49.66B on-ledger transfer day on Oct 19 (Santiment, via a crypto blog) and nearly $60B in XRP futures volume for all of September. Transfer volume also counts exchange and internal wallet moves, so it is not buying.
claims.check_title: Tangem News: September XRP futures volume near $60 billion

claims.claim: RUMORS: Ripple National Trust Bank will replace the Federal Reserve
claims.who: Circulating on X; debunked by community account XRP Herald, Oct 27
claims.check: False. The OCC charter covers managing RLUSD reserves, acting as collateral trustee and digital asset custody. A trust bank cannot take deposits or make loans, let alone replace the central bank.
claims.check_title: CoinDesk: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank

claims.claim: JUST IN: Trump signs crypto bill into law. If your XRP is on exchanges it's not yours; message 'XRP GUIDE' and I'll show you
claims.who: Community account on X, Oct 27
claims.check: False. The CLARITY Act failed a Senate cloture vote 49 to 50 on Sept 15 and has not been signed. The 'message me for a wallet guide' pitch fits a common scam pattern; never share keys or move coins at a stranger's direction.
claims.check_title: NPR: Crypto suffers major defeat as Senate rejects Clarity Act

claims.claim: BREAKING: XRP whales now control 68.5% of the supply. Whales keep accumulating around $1.29
claims.who: X Finance Bull and reposts on X, Oct 27
claims.check: The figure is real Santiment data (10M+ XRP wallets hold about 46.87B XRP). 'Accumulating' is Santiment's interpretation; the metric does not show who owns the wallets, and it is not a price signal on its own.
claims.check_title: Santiment: XRP Whales Now Control Most Supply Since 2022

claims.claim: BREAKING: BlackRock signs MOU with Ripple partner SBI Holdings and Startale Group
claims.who: CoinGape on X, Oct 27
claims.check: The MOU is real, but it is about linking BlackRock tokenized money market funds with SBI's yen stablecoin. Ripple and XRP are not named in it, so the 'Ripple partner' framing implies a link that isn't there.
claims.check_title: Startale: BlackRock, SBI Holdings and Startale sign MOU

claims.claim: SEC delays new XRP ETF again
claims.who: Coinpedia headline and community reposts, Oct 26 to 27
claims.check: Partly true. GraniteShares itself filed to move the planned effective date of its 3x leveraged XRP funds (and BTC, ETH, SOL ones) to Nov 30. It is not an SEC ruling and has nothing to do with the spot XRP ETFs already trading.

claims.claim: BREAKING: Ripple gets final OCC approval to run a U.S. national trust bank
claims.who: Brad Garlinghouse and many community reposts on X, Oct 26
claims.check: True: Ripple's Business Wire press release says the OCC granted final approval. Some reposts overstate it: it is a fiduciary trust bank for RLUSD reserves and custody, with no deposits or lending, and it is not an XRP purchase or price event.
claims.check_title: Ripple via Business Wire: Ripple Receives Final OCC Approval to Establish National Trust Bank

claims.claim: Garlinghouse and Alderoty spotted coming out of Nasdaq in New York: 'Something monumental is happening!'
claims.who: Community account on X, Oct 26
claims.check: No source or mainstream report. Ripple executives are in New York for Swell (Oct 27 to 29), so being seen in Manhattan is expected and implies no Nasdaq deal.

claims.claim: Germany's largest stock exchange says XRP will be the backbone of the new financial system and could hit $7 to $9, even $100
claims.who: Community account on X, Oct 26
claims.check: No named speaker, no link to any Deutsche Börse statement, and no mainstream report found. Price targets like this are opinion at best.

claims.claim: JUST IN: Aviva Investors launches a tokenized share class of its £22B sterling fund on the XRP Ledger
claims.who: Community reposts on X, Oct 26
claims.check: True, and corroborated by mainstream financial press (Financial News). But the £22B is the whole fund; about £86M is in the tokenized classes, and these are fund shares, not XRP purchases.
claims.check_title: Financial News: Aviva Investors steps up digital assets push by tokenising largest fund

claims.claim: JUST IN: $XRP takes over New York City trains
claims.who: RippleXity and reposts on X, Oct 26
claims.check: The subway ads are real per videos and crypto-press reporting, timed to Swell. It is a marketing campaign; it does not signal a partnership, adoption or price move. No mainstream coverage; cost and sponsor details unconfirmed.
claims.check_title: U.Today: XRP takes over New York City subway advertising

claims.claim: BREAKING: Ripple CEO says XRP market cap will be $196 trillion in days, pricing XRP at $118,920, 'confirmed during the meeting with Trump in Las Vegas'
claims.who: Paula Talks Crypto on X, Oct 26
claims.check: No such statement or meeting is reported anywhere. A $196 trillion market cap would exceed global stock-market value. No mainstream or crypto-press corroboration.

claims.claim: $27,000,000,000,000 BlackRock to sell Ripple XRP!!!
claims.who: Jake's XRP Community on X, Oct 26
claims.check: No source given and no reporting exists; $27 trillion is far larger than XRP's roughly $82B market cap. BlackRock has no XRP product or filing.

claims.claim: XRP priced at $327,000 on a private ledger, confirmed by a researcher; part of a network capacity test
claims.who: Paula Talks Crypto on X, Oct 26
claims.check: No named researcher, ledger or data is given, and no outlet has reported it. Treat as fiction.

claims.claim: FINAL 12-HOUR WARNING: THE RESET IS LIVE ... the old financial rails stop and the new system takes over
claims.who: 'Senator Cynthia lummis RV' account on X (not the senator), Oct 26
claims.check: Countdown-style 'reset' and ISO switch posts from an impersonation-style account fit common scam patterns; nothing is switching off. Do not click links or move coins based on posts like this.

claims.claim: JUST IN: Payments giant Mastercard has reportedly praised Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin during the XRP Ledger Hackathon in New York
claims.who: Community reposts on X (originating with XRPL community member Lost Art, Oct 24)
claims.check: The praise was reported from the event floor and Mastercard is a listed hackathon partner, but it was a compliment, not a deal: no Mastercard product, XRPL integration or XRP support was announced. Crypto press corroboration only, no mainstream coverage.
claims.check_title: U.Today: Mastercard praises Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin

claims.claim: RIPPLE XRP GLOBAL TAKEOVER CONFIRMED! XRP Powers BIS Unified Ledger & Cross-Border Payments
claims.who: @APEXCONSULTNFA (about 3K views)
claims.check: The only BIS link is Working Paper 1374, a prototype that stamps fingerprints of statistics on the XRP Ledger; the authors call it blockchain-agnostic, the BIS says research is not an endorsement, and Ripple says it has no current BIS partnership. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: Bitcoin.com News: Ripple no longer with BIS task force

claims.claim: Why is Ripple planning to release 1.3 billion XRP on November 1st instead of 1 billion? ... a BlackRock ETF or some type of announcement?
claims.who: @XRPMoonWalkK (about 7.8K views)
claims.check: The scheduled Nov 1 escrow release is up to 1 billion XRP, the same as every month; about $1.3 billion is its dollar value at today's price, not a bigger unlock. Nothing links it to BlackRock. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: TokenPost: Ripple schedules up to 1 billion XRP escrow release for Nov. 1
